title: group_gate refuses the whole gate when one kb/<dir>/settings.json has a directory name that is not a plain name
goal: group_gate runs the gate_checks of the readable kb roots and does not fail the whole gate for a kb directory whose name layered refuses as not a plain name

run:
import json,sys,tempfile,pathlib
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
T=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
d=T/"kb"/"odd dir"; d.mkdir(parents=True)
(d/"settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"gate_checks":[["true"]]}))
import kg_sync
f=kg_sync.group_gate(T)
sys.exit(0 if not f else "not yet: "+str(f)[:300])

gates.question: How does group_gate treat a kb directory whose name kbsettings.layered refuses as not a plain name?
options: skip it silently, kg_sync keeping its own PLAIN_ROOT_NAME pattern
skip it and name it in a warning line
fail the gate for that directory only
gates.recommendation: skip it silently, kg_sync keeping its own PLAIN_ROOT_NAME pattern
gates.reason: the repro needs no failure, and kbsettings.py is outside the touches, so a public helper there is a follow-up
gates.answer: skip it silently, kg_sync keeping its own PLAIN_ROOT_NAME pattern
